rule: Character creation applies, in order: start place from the race and class row; default skills; custom spells (only when the config flag is on); action bar from the per-race-class button table; start outfit from a DBC not in the box; start items table (one placeholder row); collector voucher naming the first town per race. The opener is a single quest giver who starts and ends a chain of kill-8 steps with a return, with the mob level band rising by step, and a final quest that reports to the first hub. Tutorial hints are one-shot bits, 256 per account, set by a client packet that names the bit.
keep: Start-kit table keyed by race and class (same shape as playercreateinfo)
One quest giver who starts and ends his own chain
Kill-8 step with a return, then a report that moves the player to the hub
Level band climbs one step at a time, normal rank, no scripted rigging
One-shot hint bits per account (one ledger)
change: No placeholder rows in the chain or the item kit
No garbled test quest in the start path
Ring fight replaces the single Vermin; max three attackers
Hint bits show once, then stay set; our own copy

onboarding.first_90_seconds: Server gives a start place, kit table and action bar. Intro and first screen are client-side (not in box).
onboarding.first_fight_staging: Normal-rank level 1 to 2 Vermin with multipliers 1; first-hit feedback is one aggro line row (event type 4, chance 30). Winnable by level band, not script.
onboarding.first_reward_loot_level: Quest 7 gives a small raw money value and an XP-difficulty index; first level needs 400 experience; celebration is client-side (not read).
onboarding.first_hub_services: Quest 54 'Report to Goldshire' is the hand-off; trainer, gossip and vendor rows are data whose order is gated by conditions not read.
onboarding.first_meaningful_choice: None in the data read; the chain is fixed.
onboarding.pull_forward_5_10_30: Next quest from the same NPC (15 names 21 as next), then the report to the hub. Minute timing not in data.
onboarding.tutorial_style: Forced chain from one quest giver; optional one-shot hints (256 bits per account); first quest text about 220 characters; skippable not read.
onboarding.drop_off_risks: Three kill-8 and return steps before the hub; placeholder quest rows (73, 108). Avoids: level band climbs, no surprise jump.
onboarding.could_be_ours: Four-step opener in the ring with one quest giver and a once-only hotbar hint.

look_test: Four-step opener in the gladiator ring: fight 1 vs level 1, fight 2 vs level 2, fight 3 vs level 3, then a report card that opens the bank. One-shot hotbar hint shows once. Judge: step count readable at 375 wide, hint shows once only, report card is the obvious next tap, 2 to 4 hotbar buttons feel clear.
